column2: What method has the advantage of reducing all revenues and costs to a single percentage number?
column3:
a. IPO
b. ROR
c. IRR
d. IRA
e. Both b and c 

Answer
e.  Both b and c

Using the internal rate of return (IRR) or rate of return (ROR) method has the advantage of reducing all revenues and costs to a single percentage number.

Chapter 7; page 259

column2: How can we make the best decision?
column3:
Manager may make the decision based on not only quantitative data but also qualitative factors. The best decision methods should combine historical data, statistics, and analysis with experience, judgement, common sense, and other qualitative factors.

Reference: Bowman, M. (2003). Applied economic analysis for technologists, engineers, and managers. (2nd ed. p. 275) Upper Saddle River, NJ: Prentice Hall.
